newsitem.title: USA: Avatex settles with Foxmeyer trustee.
newsitem.headline: Avatex settles with Foxmeyer trustee.

text.p: Avatex Corp, formerly FoxMeyer Health Corp, said on Tuesday it has reached a settlement with the trustee of FoxMeyer Corp and its subsidiaries over litigation related to the transfer of certain assets.
FoxMeyer Corp filed for relief under the bankruptcy code in August 1996.
Under the settlement, Avatex will pay the trustee $25 million from funds that were restricted in the case and execute a three year, interest bearing $8 million promissory note payable to the trustee.

In exchange, the trustee will release Avatex from all claims and other restrictions on its operations and provide Avatex with a 30 percent interest, up to $10 million, in the net proceeds of certain litigation that may be brought by the trustee against specified third parties.
Under the settlement, Avatex's 30 percent interest must be first used to satisfy its obligation under the $8 million note.
The settlement is subject to approval by the presiding U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware.

Although Avatex said it strongly believes that the trustee's claims are without merit and denied any liability with respect to the bankruptcy, the company said it believes the settlement is an essential step in restoring Avatex's liquidity and accelerating its effort to maximize the value of its assets.

In addition, the settlement specifically provides for the immediate use of $6 million in connection with a potential purchase of a 30.2 percent interest in Hamilton Morgan LLC from its minority investor, Robert Haft, Avatex said.
Avatex currently holds a 69.8 percent interest in Hamilton Morgan, a limited liability company whose sole investment is its approximate 31 percent stake in Phar-Mor, Inc.
Under the settlement, the Phar-Mor stock will be delivered to the trustee as collateral for the $8 million note.
Avatex also separately owns about an 8 percent stake in Phar-Mor, which operates a chain of over 100 discount drugstores.
